content: परि {%ind.%} (Sometimes changed to परी, as परिवाह or परीवाह, परिहास or परीहास) .²1 As a prefix to verbs and nouns derived from them, it means .³({%a%}) round, round about, about; .³({%b%}) in addition to, further; .³({%c%}) opposite to, against; .³({%d%}) much, excessively. .²2 As a separable preposition it means .³({%a%}) towards, in the direction of, to, opposite to (with an <ab>acc.</ab>); वृक्षं परि विद्योतते विद्युत्; .³({%b%}) successively, severally (with an <ab>acc.</ab>); वृक्षं वृक्षं परि सिञ्चति ‘he waters tree after tree’; .³({%c%}) to the share or lot of (showing भाग or participation) (with <ab>acc.</ab>); यदत्र मां परि स्यात् ‘what may fall to my lot’; or लक्ष्मीर्हरिं परि <ls>Sk.</ls>; .³({%d%}) from, out of; .³({%e%}) except, outside of, with the exception of (with <ab>abl.</ab>); परि त्रिगर्तेभ्यो वृष्टो देवः or पर्यनन्तात् त्रयस्तापाः <ls>Vop.</ls>; .³({%f%}) after the lapse of; परि संवत्सरात्; .³({%g%}) in consequence of; .³({%h%}) beyond, more than; भृत्याः परि चतुर्दश <ls>Mb. 3. 1. 11</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> अधिकचतुर्दशाः पञ्चदशेत्यर्थः); .³({%i%}) according to, in accordance with; .³({%j%}) above, over. .²3 As an adverbial prefix to nouns not directly connected with verbs, it means ‘very’, ‘very much’, ‘excessively’; as in पर्यश्रु ‘bursting into tears’; so परिचतुर्दशन्, परिदौर्बल्य. .²4 At the beginning of adverbial compounds परि means .³({%a%}) without, except, outside, with the exception of; as in परित्रिगर्तं वृष्टो दिवः <ls>P. II. 1. 12</ls>, <ls n="P.">VI. 2. 33</ls>. (According to <ls>P. II. 1. 10</ls> परि may be used at the end of adverbial <ab>comp.</ab> after अक्ष, शलाका), and a numeral to denote loss or defeat in a game by an unlucky or adverse cast of dice (द्यूतव्यवहारे पराजये एवायं समासः) {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} अक्षपरि, शलाकापरि, एकपरि; <ab>cf.</ab> अक्षपरि; .³({%b%}) round about, all round, surrounded by; as in पर्यग्नि ‘in the midst of flames’. .²5 At the end of an adjectival <ab>comp.</ab> परि has the sense of ‘exhausted by’, or ‘feeling repugnance for’; as in पर्यध्ययनः = परिग्लानोऽध्ययनाय.
